🎥🎬: Braceface (2001–2004)

Sharon Spitz is an ordinary teenager trying to survive high school, friendships, first crushes, and the everyday awkwardness of growing up. Thanks to a strange electromagnetic reaction, her braces have a habit of going completely haywire at the worst possible moments, turning simple situations into unforgettable disasters.

As Sharon navigates life with her best friends Maria and Connor, every embarrassing mishap becomes a lesson in confidence, honesty, and self-acceptance. Blending comedy with relatable coming-of-age stories, Braceface captures the ups and downs of being a teenager while reminding viewers that nobody has life completely figured out.

source_details.synopsis: Braceface is a Canadian coming-of-age teen sitcom-drama animated television series co-produced by Nelvana Limited and Jade Animation (Shenzhen) Company that aired on Teletoon (now known as "Cartoon Network" in Canada). The show features U.S. actress Alicia Silverstone from the teen comedy film Clueless (who also voiced the title character for the first two seasons) serving as executive producer. The episodes focus on the misadventures of Sharon Spitz, a high school student who often struggles with an unusual ability occurring in her braces, which often makes mishaps in her daily life.
